content.short: Storm Trade is a TON perpetual futures DEX for leveraged trading from Telegram or the web.
content.description: Storm Trade is a decentralized perpetual futures exchange on TON. Its site describes self-custodial leverage trading on markets such as Bitcoin, Ethereum, Tesla, and gold, plus Telegram Web App access and stablecoin staking. The product is a derivatives venue, not a simple spot swap interface. Trade perpetual futures on Bitcoin, Ethereum, Tesla, Gold on TON Blockchain, in safe, self-custodial way. Important product areas are decentralized perpetual exchange, trade with leverage on ton, ton/usd, and dex on ton.
